title: STEMEd+ Conferences: a conference series
description: One recurring conference, with its upcoming meetings. One file per series in conferences/. List only meetings run by a scholarly or professional society (US or international) or funded by a US federal agency. If you are not sure a meeting meets that rule, or might be predatory, leave it out.

name.description: Series name as the sponsor gives it, e.g. NARST Annual International Conference.

short.description: Short name or acronym, e.g. NARST.

sponsors.description: The societies, associations, or agencies that run or fund it.

sponsor_type.description: US society: a US-based scholarly or professional society or association. International society: one based outside the US or organized internationally. US federal agency: funded by NSF, NIH, NASA, USDA, NOAA, the Department of Education, or another US agency (say how in funding_note).

funding_note.description: For federally funded meetings: which agency and how (e.g. hosted by AACC with NSF support).

kind.description: education: a conference about STEM+ teaching, learning, or education research. track: a discipline meeting with education sessions, divisions, or tracks. field: a meeting of a field-scope discipline (History & Philosophy of Science, Human Dimensions, Science & Health Communication).

disciplines.description: Labels from the STEMEd+ discipline list (stemed_conferences/stemedplus_disciplines.json, kept in HuMeta). Leave empty for meetings that cover all STEM+ fields.

url.description: The sponsor's page for the series.

schedule.description: When it usually happens and when proposals are usually due, in a sentence.

travel_support.description: Travel awards, student scholarships, stipends, or registration support, in a sentence.

summary.description: Who it is for and what happens there, in your own words.

checked.description: When someone last checked this file against the sponsor's pages.

notes.description: Notes for maintainers; not shown on the site.

meetings.description: Announced meetings. Past ones may stay; the site hides them.

city.description: City and state or province, e.g. Boston, Massachusetts. 'Online' for virtual meetings.

dates_source.description: official: dates and place are on the sponsor's own page for this meeting. announced: the sponsor or a partner society has announced them, but the meeting page does not show them yet.

label.description: e.g. Proposals due, Early registration ends, Travel award applications due.
